campaigns_rule_ck.name: campaigns_rule_ck
campaigns_rule_ck.value: ("campaigns"."kind" = 'automated') = ("campaigns"."rule_type" is not null) and ("campaigns"."rule_type" is null or "campaigns"."rule_type" in ('recall', 'birthday', 'win_back', 'package_expiring', 'routing_abandoned'))

coupons_limits_ck.name: coupons_limits_ck
coupons_limits_ck.value: ("coupons"."max_uses" is null or "coupons"."max_uses" > 0) and ("coupons"."per_customer_limit" is null or "coupons"."per_customer_limit" > 0)

coupons_dates_ck.name: coupons_dates_ck
coupons_dates_ck.value: "coupons"."valid_from" is null or "coupons"."valid_to" is null or "coupons"."valid_from" < "coupons"."valid_to"

customer_credits_sign_ck.name: customer_credits_sign_ck
customer_credits_sign_ck.value:
"customer_credits"."change" <> 0 and (
    ("customer_credits"."kind" in ('purchase', 'renewal', 'grant', 'return') and "customer_credits"."change" > 0) or
    ("customer_credits"."kind" in ('use', 'expiry') and "customer_credits"."change" < 0) or "customer_credits"."kind" = 'adjust')

media_assets_bytes_present.name: media_assets_bytes_present
media_assets_bytes_present.value: "media_assets"."data" is not null or ("media_assets"."storage_key" is not null and "media_assets"."key_version" is not null)

membership_plans_benefit_ck.name: membership_plans_benefit_ck
membership_plans_benefit_ck.value: "membership_plans"."credits_per_period" between 0 and 100 and "membership_plans"."member_discount_percent" between 0 and 100 and ("membership_plans"."credits_per_period" > 0 or "membership_plans"."member_discount_percent" > 0)

memberships_quiet_hours_valid.name: memberships_quiet_hours_valid
memberships_quiet_hours_valid.value: ("memberships"."quiet_start_minute" is null and "memberships"."quiet_end_minute" is null) or ("memberships"."quiet_start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "memberships"."quiet_end_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "memberships"."quiet_start_minute" <> "memberships"."quiet_end_minute")

oauth_device_codes_approved_ck.name: oauth_device_codes_approved_ck
oauth_device_codes_approved_ck.value: "oauth_device_codes"."status" not in ('approved', 'used') or ("oauth_device_codes"."tenant_id" is not null and "oauth_device_codes"."grant_id" is not null)

onboarding_progress_one_state.name: onboarding_progress_one_state
onboarding_progress_one_state.value: not ("onboarding_progress"."done_at" is not null and "onboarding_progress"."skipped_at" is not null)

payments_target_ck.name: payments_target_ck
payments_target_ck.value: "payments"."appointment_id" is not null or ("payments"."patient_id" is not null and "payments"."location_id" is not null)

push_subscriptions_owner_ck.name: push_subscriptions_owner_ck
push_subscriptions_owner_ck.value:
("push_subscriptions"."owner_type" = 'staff' and "push_subscriptions"."membership_id" is not null and "push_subscriptions"."patient_id" is null)
      or ("push_subscriptions"."owner_type" = 'customer' and "push_subscriptions"."patient_id" is not null and "push_subscriptions"."membership_id" is null)

services_window_dates_ordered.name: services_window_dates_ordered
services_window_dates_ordered.value: "services"."booking_window_kind" <> 'date_range' or ("services"."booking_window_from" is not null and "services"."booking_window_through" is not null and "services"."booking_window_through" >= "services"."booking_window_from")

services_class_capacity.name: services_class_capacity
services_class_capacity.value: ("services"."kind" = 'class' and "services"."capacity" between 1 and 500) or ("services"."kind" = 'appointment' and "services"."capacity" is null)

services_after_booking_valid.name: services_after_booking_valid
services_after_booking_valid.value: "services"."after_booking" in ('kalendr_page', 'redirect') and ("services"."after_booking" <> 'redirect' or "services"."redirect_url" is not null)

special_links_shape_ck.name: special_links_shape_ck
special_links_shape_ck.value:
("special_links"."kind" = 'single_use' and "special_links"."max_uses" = 1)
    or ("special_links"."kind" = 'limited' and "special_links"."max_uses" between 2 and 1000)
    or ("special_links"."kind" = 'expiring' and "special_links"."max_uses" is null and "special_links"."expires_at" is not null)

sso_connections_saml_ck.name: sso_connections_saml_ck
sso_connections_saml_ck.value: "sso_connections"."kind" <> 'saml' or ("sso_connections"."idp_entity_id" is not null and "sso_connections"."idp_sso_url" is not null and "sso_connections"."idp_certificate" is not null)

sso_connections_oidc_ck.name: sso_connections_oidc_ck
sso_connections_oidc_ck.value: "sso_connections"."kind" <> 'oidc' or ("sso_connections"."oidc_issuer" is not null and "sso_connections"."oidc_client_id" is not null and "sso_connections"."oidc_client_secret_enc" is not null)

tax_settings_registered_ck.name: tax_settings_registered_ck
tax_settings_registered_ck.value: not "tax_settings"."registered" or ("tax_settings"."gstin" is not null and "tax_settings"."state_code" is not null and "tax_settings"."legal_name" is not null)

tenant_data_keys_shape_valid.name: tenant_data_keys_shape_valid
tenant_data_keys_shape_valid.value:
("tenant_data_keys"."provider" = 'legacy' and "tenant_data_keys"."version" = 0 and "tenant_data_keys"."wrapped_key" is null)
      or ("tenant_data_keys"."provider" <> 'legacy' and "tenant_data_keys"."version" > 0 and "tenant_data_keys"."wrapped_key" is not null and "tenant_data_keys"."master_key_id" is not null)

workflow_steps_body_length.name: workflow_steps_body_length
workflow_steps_body_length.value: char_length("workflow_steps"."body") <= 2000 and (char_length("workflow_steps"."body") >= 1 or "workflow_steps"."template_key" is not null)
